import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 50;
    static final int iinf = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final long linf = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static int n, m, k, c, d, mxt;
    static int s, t, fn;
    static List<Integer>[] e;
    static List<Integer> to, fw, co;
    static int[] dep, pre;
    static boolean[] vis;

    static void adde(int u, int v, int w, int c) {
        e[u].add(to.size()); to.add(v); fw.add(w); co.add(c);
        e[v].add(to.size()); to.add(u); fw.add(0); co.add(-c);
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dep, iinf);
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        vis[s] = true;
        dep[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            vis[u] = false;
            for (int vIdx : e[u]) {
                int v = to.get(vIdx);
                if (fw.get(vIdx) > 0 && dep[v] > dep[u] + co.get(vIdx)) {
                    dep[v] = dep[u] + co.get(vIdx);
                    pre[v] = vIdx;
                    if (!vis[v]) {
                        q.offer(v);
                        vis[v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dep[t] < iinf;
    }

    static long[] mcmf() {
        long flowSum = 0;
        long costSum = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int f = iinf;
            for (int u = t; u != s; u = to.get(pre[u] ^ 1)) {
                f = Math.min(f, fw.get(pre[u]));
            }
            for (int u = t; u != s; u = to.get(pre[u] ^ 1)) {
                int preEdge = pre[u];
                fw.set(preEdge, fw.get(preEdge) - f);
                fw.set(preEdge ^ 1, fw.get(preEdge ^ 1) + f);
            }
            flowSum += f;
            costSum += (long) dep[t] * f;
        }
        return new long[]{flowSum, costSum};
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mxt = N * 3 + 1;

        s = 0;
        to = new ArrayList<>();
        fw = new ArrayList<>();
        co = new ArrayList<>();
        e = new ArrayList[ (t = (s = n * mxt) + 1) + 2 ];
        for (int i = 0; i < e.length; i++) e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        dep = new int[e.length];
        pre = new int[e.length];
        vis = new boolean[e.length];

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            adde(s, u, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int p = 1; p <= k + 1; p++) {
                adde(i * n + u, (i + 1) * n + v, 1, 2 * d * p - d);
                adde(i * n + v, (i + 1) * n + u, 1, 2 * d * p - d);
            }
        }

        for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < mxt - 1; i++) {
                adde(i * n + u, (i + 1) * n + u, k, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < mxt; i++) {
            adde(i * n, t, k, c * i);
        }

        long[] ans = mcmf();
        if (ans[0] != k) {
            throw new AssertionError();
        }
        System.out.println(ans[1]);
    }
}
